levels.surface: محمد بن الحسن بن أحمد بن الوليد

notes: «وَ بِهَذَا الْإِسْنَادِ» opens the report; prev1 to prev3 open with the same phrase and write no names, so the names come from prev4 (its chain_text), the nearest report that writes its chain.
The report's own «عن أبان بن تغلب» repeats prev4's last name and is written here as the report's link.
The Imam after the chain (قال قال أبو عبد الله) is imam_in_text, the last link (owner ruling 2).
